shared_elements: animals/figures oriented in the same direction as a loose procession
justification: Both surfaces show profile quadrupeds accompanied by human figures moving in a shared direction, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural art offers. Beyond that they diverge completely: A is a dense, overlapping field of tiny schematic outline forms dominated by boat/keel shapes and stick-like people with no framing, while B is a single large naturalistically modelled humped animal led by robed attendants carrying objects, set between horizontal rosette borders.
